mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 5% over two consecutive quarters signals a restrictive monetary regime that raises discount rates and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of quarters when FEDFUNDS > 5% for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 of more than 2% signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts positive 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of quarters when GDPC1 falls by more than 2% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in UNRATE above 4.5% for three consecutive months indicates a tight labor market, which raises wage inflation and input costs, ultimately reducing profit margins and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 5-day forward returns in more than 70% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for three months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in INDPRO and a fall in HOUST over the same month signals supply chain inflation without corresponding demand growth, which erodes real earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 0% and HOUST < 0% in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months when INDPRO rises and HOUST falls simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in PAYEMS of more than 1% month-over-month signals significant job losses, which directly reduce consumer spending and corporate revenues, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts positive 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of months when PAYEMS falls by more than 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A coordinated rise in GDPC1 and RSAFS over two consecutive months signals robust consumer spending and liquidity expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and RSAFS both rise for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both GDPC1 and RSAFS rise for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp one-month increase in FEDFUNDS of more than 0.75 percentage points signals an unexpected tightening, which raises risk-free rates and equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 5-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS jumps by more than 0.75% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in INDPRO and a rise in CPIAUCSL over three consecutive months signals cost-push inflation, which compresses real margins and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 0% and CPIAUCSL > 0% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO falls and CPIAUCSL rises for three consecutive months.
